builds.howItPlays: You set cheap cards face down at the battlefields, paying 1 Energy through Teemo instead of spending a rune, then play them for free in the middle of a fight. Teemo, Scout arrives with +3 Might for that turn and Windsinger sends a unit with 3 Might or less back to its owner's hand, so you take battlefields your opponent thought were safe.
builds.whyYou: You like being the player your opponent can't read, with a row of face-down cards that could be anything. You enjoy grabbing battlefields early and then springing a surprise on whatever the other player sends into a fight, so every attack they make feels risky. You don't mind thinking on both players' turns about which card to flip and when. If you have as much fun playing mind games as playing units, Teemo is your Legend.
builds.ratingNotes: 2026-09-25 re-rate. Scored decks: Teemo 4.1 (chaix) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/54ab7032-35e0-47ca-8df6-ac73c5c7413d Tempo 7/6.5/7.5/4; Blue Teemo 1v1 (Darkmatter43, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/6381aead-50be-44dc-95fb-018151f1a94a Tempo 6/6/8/3.5; new teemo agro (Dani Timchenko, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/682ecd86-8c84-4f48-a6f2-a09ac853d7fd Tempo 6.5/5.5/8/4.5. Mean from `tools.ts style`: Tempo 6.5/6/8/4. Adjustments on all three sheets: complexity +1 (the Legend lets you hide a card for 1 Energy instead of a rune and pick Teemos back up to replay them, a choice every turn); variance -0.5 (Grove of the God-Willow and Dusk Rose Lab or Startipped Peak give extra cards or runes). Deciding cards: Pace comes from about nine units costing 2 (Teemo, Scout; Evelynn, Entrancing; Tideturner; Windsinger; Sneaky Deckhand) against only three cards costing 5+. Stance comes from 18 pressure cards (plus Sprite Call and Sprite Fountain tokens) against 8 answers. Complexity comes from 24 Hidden or Reaction cards in 40, plus Switcheroo and Temporal Breach. Variance: no luck-flagged cards, 0.60 of the deck in 3-ofs, and Consult the Past and card-drawing battlefields for refills. Teemo, Strategist's reveal of 5 cards is the only unseen-card effect, and it runs as 1 to 3 copies. Teemo 4.1 is judged Tempo over the scorer's Aggro (pace 7 and stance 6.5 sit on the Aggro line) because 24 of its cards are Hidden or Reaction. Legend ability: you may pay 1 Energy to hide a card with Hidden instead of a rune; for 1 Energy and exhausting Teemo, you can put a Teemo unit you own into your hand from your Champion Zone or the board. What moved since the 2026-09-22 rating: variance 7 to 4. The old rating read Strategist's reveal damage as a core swing, but the reveal is one card in a deck of full playsets and steady card flow. Pace 7.5 to 6.5 and complexity 7.5 to 8 (both within 1.5). deckListUrl was the bare /decks page. I dropped the riftbound.gg guide from guideUrls: it is dated 2026-07-17, shows no decklist, and names none of this list's key cards, so I can't confirm it describes this list rather than a pre-ban Stacked Deck one. Its raters called it Midrange, 5.5/7/7.5/4, under 2 from this Build on every Axis: https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/f9512210-2056-439d-bb79-4f4d6d6bc458 (MipZ), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/9c46250e-b875-48f5-8edb-bedf9f8d6781 (Shush), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/2b751fc5-2f8c-440a-ae5e-d6d8e1cfe298 (Osteoporosis), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/c9fffdae-56fe-47b7-8d46-0ee04bae131e (Gale TS, Spiderspam). Confidence: medium. Reviewer: the style's strong evidence (Entchen, Willem Manley) is all illegal pre-ban lists, and the legal decks shown carry 1 like each. Check post-ban lists from the Los Angeles RQ (2026-09-25 to 27) on a later pass.
